## Earnie 2.5.2

Official **PATCH** after **2.5.1**. Focus: Analyse period navigation and Chart 1 Ist↔SoC consistency.

### Highlights

- **Analyse Verbrauch & Kosten** — rolling **7** / **28**-day windows (←/→ by window length) instead of calendar ISO weeks; KPIs for the selected window plus trailing 365 days of log data
- **Chart 1 Ist battery vs SoC** — when the instantaneous Ist battery sign opposes the SoC step to the next present slot, history bars use SoC-implied mean power (interim; durable QH energy sampling remains on the backlog)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.2`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Legacy aliases: `ghcr.io/jochentcc/ernie-energy:2.5.2` / `:latest`

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

See [backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md).
